current.title: Adrenaline
current.line: Haunted-house season: a good scare releases adrenaline, the surge that readies the body for a burst of action.

weeks.title: β-Carotene
weeks.line: Leaf-peeping season: as leaves stop renewing their green chlorophyll, pigments like β-carotene show through as yellow and orange.

weeks.title: Americium
weeks.line: Fire Prevention Week: many home smoke alarms hold a speck of americium, a synthetic element whose radiation helps the alarm sense smoke.

weeks.title: Quinine
weeks.line: Tonic water gets its bitterness from quinine, which also makes the drink glow blue under a black light.

weeks.title: Cinnamaldehyde
weeks.line: Pumpkin spice has no pumpkin in it. It leads with cinnamon, and cinnamaldehyde is the molecule that makes cinnamon taste like cinnamon.
